goal: Navigate to the login form, enter email and password using keyboard only, and submit the form. Verify error messages are announced by the screen reader when login fails.
Switch between login and sign-up modes using keyboard navigation, ensuring all interactive elements are accessible and labeled correctly for screen readers.
Navigate through the settings form using keyboard only, modify settings, and save changes. Ensure screen reader announces form field labels and any error messages.
Verify that loading indicators and success messages are announced by the screen reader when settings are being fetched or saved.
Ensure that all toggle switches and checkboxes are accessible via keyboard and correctly announce their state (checked/unchecked) to screen readers.
